evidence: Moderna's S-1 records Afeyan as co-founder and chairman since incorporation and Bancel as founding CEO and a director, and both were at Flagship Pioneering when Moderna was built (Bancel became a Flagship Senior Partner in July 2011).
Moderna's S-1 names both men among the people who founded Moderna: Afeyan led the Flagship VentureLabs team and Langer is listed as a co-founder.
Beam Therapeutics' S-1/A states the company was founded in 2017 by David Liu, Feng Zhang and Keith Joung; both are also named founders of Editas Medicine in its S-1/A.
Editas Medicine's S-1/A names Feng Zhang, George Church, David Liu and J. Keith Joung among the company's founders.
Editas Medicine's S-1/A names both George Church and David Liu among the company's founders.
Editas Medicine's S-1/A names both as founders of Editas, though it notes Doudna was no longer involved with the company by the time of the IPO.
Vida Ventures, where Belldegrun is Senior Managing Director, is an investor in Capstan Therapeutics, which Carl June co-founded; Capstan's launch release names Vida Ventures among the seed investors.
Capstan Therapeutics' launch release names RA Capital, the firm Peter Kolchinsky founded, among the investors in the November 2021 seed round of the company Carl June co-founded.
ARCH Venture Partners, which Nelsen co-founded, is named by Koller herself as one of insitro's founding backers, and insitro appears on ARCH's own portfolio page.
Altos Labs' launch release places Klausner (Chief Scientist and Founder) and Barron (incoming CEO) together as co-chairs of the Altos board of directors.
GRAIL's S-1 records Huber as one of GRAIL's founders and founding CEO, and Lyell's S-1 describes Klausner as a co-founder of GRAIL; both also sat on GRAIL's board.
Arc Institute's own launch release states the institute is founded by Silvana Konermann, Patrick Hsu and Patrick Collison; both remain Arc co-founders and core investigators.

Stylus Medicine's launch release names RA Capital Management, the firm Kolchinsky founded, as a founding investor of the company for which Hsu is Scientific Founder; RA's Joshua Resnick sits on the Stylus board with Hsu.
EQRx's S-1 lists Eli Casdin, Jorge Conde and Krishna Yeshwant together on the EQRx board of directors.
EQRx's S-1 lists Eli Casdin and Krishna Yeshwant together on the EQRx board of directors, both joining Legacy EQRx in January 2020.
EQRx's S-1 lists Jorge Conde and Krishna Yeshwant together among EQRx's directors.
Konermann completed her PhD in Feng Zhang's laboratory at MIT and the Broad Institute, where she did the pioneering CRISPRa and Cas13 work she is known for.
a16z's partner page names Conde cofounder and CEO of Knome; Church's own tech-transfer page records Knome (2007) with his founder marker, so both co-founded the same company.
a16z's partner page records that Conde served on the board of Tmunity through its acquisition by Gilead/Kite; Tmunity's own release names Carl June its co-founder and chief scientific advisor.
Both are general partners on the Andreessen Horowitz Bio + Health team; a16z's own pages carry both biographies.
Editas Medicine's S-1/A names both David Liu and Jennifer Doudna among the company's founders, though it records that Doudna had left by the time of the IPO.
Altos Labs' launch release places Robert Nelsen on the board of the company Klausner founded and co-chairs; ARCH's own portfolio page lists Altos Labs.

ARCH Venture Partners' own portfolio page lists Aera Therapeutics, Arbor Biotechnologies, Beam Therapeutics and Moonwalk Biosciences - four companies Feng Zhang founded or co-founded - and Nelsen is quoted as a backer in the Aera and Moonwalk releases.
ARCH's portfolio page lists Beam Therapeutics, Prime Medicine and nChroma Bio, all companies David Liu co-founded; Nelsen is quoted in Prime Medicine's launch release.
Prime Medicine's launch release names Casdin Capital among the Series B investors in the company David Liu co-founded; Casdin's 13F also reports a Prime Medicine position.

Hsu did his PhD at Harvard and the Broad Institute where he was an early pioneer of CRISPR-Cas9 work alongside Feng Zhang's group, and was on the initial team at Editas Medicine, which Zhang co-founded.
